B_F1.prior_disclosure: 我方部署生成器 2026-09-05 cloud 测得库大小均值 311 (真实 val 375)、基因均值 Pearson 0.997；阈值不因此调整

w1.why_not_table1_ruler: Table 1 的 W1 是 score_w1_paper 那把 raw-counts 尺，参照是 per-type matched n 的真实 val；这里的参照是一份 20000 条的混合 val 子样本，两者不可互换，故不冒用尺子之名

e21.reference: the same 20000-cell val subsample (NOT Table 1's per-type matched n) -- calibre stated, not borrowed

fano.definition: var(ddof=1)/mean over genes with mean>0; median across genes

rows.required_footnote: our implementation for count data; the released code targets images (CIFAR-10 / MNIST / CelebA) and provides no scRNA entry point. Backbone and capacity are matched to ours.
rows.subsample_note: PREREG R2: scored on the FULL pool (n_pool == n_scored == 20000). The other generators are scored on the first 20000 rows of a 100000 pool. Same n, same ruler, same code path; subsample_seed is null because no subsampling occurred.
rows.T_selection_rule: PREREG R1: the T with the higher local_sanity.gene_mean_pearson_log on machine 2's sidecars (9/9 seed-pair separation); frozen before any machine-1 number existed. Selected: Blackout Diffusion (Santos et al., 2023) -> T=32
